memories.content: The second-line team handles escalated warranty claims. They have a queue of claims and must decide on each. They are aware of the ten-working-day commitment but may have varying workloads and priorities.

Rustam's escalated warranty claim for a failed washing machine was submitted to the manufacturer. Yesterday (2026-08-04), the manufacturer sent an email to Rustam quoting that the second-line team would make a decision within ten working days. The ten working days from 2026-08-04 end on 2026-08-18 (assuming weekdays only). The simulation starts on 2026-08-05 at 09:00 and has a hard cutoff at 2026-08-19T18:00:00+05:00.
